Council Meetings

On this page you will find the dates, agendas and minutes for Meetings of the Goomalling Shire Council.

Ordinary meetings of the Goomalling Shire Council will be held on the following Wednesdays of 2025 in the Goomalling Shire Council Chambers, 32 Quinlan Street, Goomalling. Members of the public are welcome to attend. Public question time is from 5.00pm to 5.15pm, at the start of the Ordinary Council Meeting.

For details, please ring 08 9629 1101 or email goshire@goomalling.wa.gov.au

Written submissions are to be received by the second Wednesday of the month, with late correspondence accepted up to two days before the meeting.

Agendas & Minutes

Agendas for Council meetings are available to Elected Members and the public on the Friday prior to the Council meeting and are available at the Shire Administration Office or viewed online as per below.

Minutes of Council Meetings are made available within ten (10) days after the meeting was held. These minutes are unconfirmed at the time they are published and are submitted to Council at their next meeting for confirmation.

A hardcopy of the minutes is available at the Shire Office. If you wish to subscribe to receive a copy of the minutes each month (refer to current Fees and Charges for cost of this service) please send your request to goshire@goomalling.wa.gov.au or phone (08) 9629 1101.

Disclaimer

The purpose of Council Meetings is to discuss and, where possible, make resolutions about items appearing on the agenda. Whilst Council has the power to resolve such items and may in fact, appear to have done so at the meeting, no person should rely on or act on the basis of such decision or on any advice or information provided by a Member or Officer, or on the content of any discussion occurring, during the course of the meeting.

Persons should be aware that the provisions of the Local Government Act 1995 (Section 5.25 (e)) establish procedures for revocation or revision of a Council decision. No person should rely on the decisions made by Council until formal advice of the Council decision is received by that person. The Shire of Goomalling expressly disclaims liability for any loss or damage suffered by any person as a result of relying on or acting on the basis of any resolution of Council, or any advice or information provided by a Member or Officer, or the content of any discussion occurring, during the course of the Council meeting.

Acknowledgment of Country

We acknowledge this land that we meet and work on is part of the traditional lands of the Nyoongar people and that we respect their spiritual relationship with their country. We also acknowledge the  Nyoongar  Ballardong  people  as the custodians of the greater Goomalling/Koomal area and that their cultural and heritage beliefs are still important to the living Nyoongar Ballardong people.
